conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
AZO DYE COUPLING REACTIONS
                         
   1. COUPLING WITH PHENOL (Basic Medium $\text{pH } 9\text{--}10$):
      $$\text{Ph-N}_2^+\text{Cl}^- + \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{OH} \xrightarrow{\text{OH}^-, \text{pH } 9\text{--}10} \mathbf{\text{HO-C}_6\text{H}_4\text{-N=N-C}_6\text{H}_5 \text{ (p-Hydroxyazobenzene / Orange Dye)}} + \text{Cl}^- + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$
      
   2. COUPLING WITH ANILINE (Acidic Medium $\text{pH } 4\text{--}5$):
      $$\text{Ph-N}_2^+\text{Cl}^- + \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{NH}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{H}^+, \text{pH } 4\text{--}5} \mathbf{\text{H}_2\text{N-C}_6\text{H}_4\text{-N=N-C}_6\text{H}_5 \text{ (p-Aminoazobenzene / Yellow Dye)}} + \text{HCl}$$
conceptBreakdown.content: The diazonium ion acts as a weak electrophile and couples at the para-position of activated aromatic rings to produce extended conjugated azo dyes.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST AMINES & DIAZONIUM TRAPS SUMMARY

1. Aniline (pKb = 9.38) is 10⁶x WEAKER than methylamine (pKb = 3.38).
2. Aqueous methyl amine basicity order is 2° > 1° > 3° > NH₃ (213).
3. Gabriel Phthalimide CANNOT synthesize Aniline (aryl halides fail S_N2).
4. Hofmann degradation produces a 1° amine with ONE LESS carbon.
5. Direct nitration of aniline gives 47% META product due to anilinium ion.
6. Hinsberg: 1° = soluble in NaOH; 2° = insoluble in NaOH; 3° = no reaction.
7. Coupling with phenol requires weakly basic medium (pH 9–10).
8. Aliphatic diazonium salts are unstable and decompose immediately.
9. Aniline fails Friedel-Crafts reactions due to AlCl₃ complexation.
10. Carbylamine test is positive ONLY for primary (1°) amines.
